plasma_propulsion.description: Electric/plasma rocket thrust from power, efficiency, and Isp
plasma_propulsion.why: Need validated numbers for ion-drive performance without hand-calculating every time

rocket_stage_dv.description: Delta-v from wet mass, dry mass, and specific impulse
rocket_stage_dv.why: Avoid hand-computing the rocket equation for every stage design

escape_velocity.description: Escape velocity from a celestial body's mass and radius
escape_velocity.why: Reusable tool for comparing escape velocities across planets and moons without re-deriving the formula each time

plasma_parameters.description: Plasma frequency, Debye length, and Debye-sphere particle count from n_e and T_e
plasma_parameters.why: Core plasma diagnostics; every plasma physicist computes these from n_e and T_e

phase_state.description: Classify a fluid's phase state (super-critical / liquid / gas / near-critical) from T and P vs. its critical point
phase_state.why: Supercritical-fluid work needs an instant read on whether a given T,P is super-critical; the reduced coordinates (Tr, Pr) are the universal way to express it

carnot_cycle.description: Maximum (Carnot) thermal efficiency between two reservoirs
carnot_cycle.why: The upper bound every real heat engine is measured against; two numbers, one answer

prob_birthday.description: Probability at least two of N people share a birthday (365-day year)
prob_birthday.why: Standard closed-form birthday problem; intuition badly underestimates it

prob_binomial.description: P(exactly k successes in n Bernoulli trials at prob p), plus mean and variance
prob_binomial.why: Core discrete distribution; needed anywhere success-count probabilities come up

prob_bayes.description: Posterior P(condition|positive test) from prevalence, sensitivity, specificity
prob_bayes.why: Base-rate fallacy: intuition says ~sensitivity when a test is '99% accurate', and is badly wrong for rare conditions

prob_normal.description: P(a <= Z <= b) for the standard normal (mean 0, sd 1)
prob_normal.why: Workhorse continuous probability lookup; closed form via erf

ee_rc.description: RC circuit: time constant, cutoff frequency, charge voltage
ee_rc.why: Standard first-order RC analysis; needed repeatedly for filter design and transient questions

ee_reactance.description: Capacitive/inductive reactance and LC resonant frequency
ee_reactance.why: Recurring AC circuit analysis; selftest values are textbook (1/(2 pi f C) etc.)

ee_power.description: Power from any two of V/I/R (incl. I^2R) and decibels for power/voltage ratios
ee_power.why: Ubiquitous EE arithmetic; selftest values are textbook (12V*2A=24W, 10log10(2)=3.0103 dB, 20log10(2)=6.0206 dB)
